title: HeardSoundPayload
description: A sound the Body heard within 24 blocks, as a compass direction and a distance band (wave PX, PX-4). PROVISIONAL vocabulary (decision 0143). Never carries coordinates: the schema rejects x, y and z.

dir.description: World-fixed direction of the sound: n is -z, s is +z, e is +x, w is -x.

band.description: Distance band: near up to 8 blocks, mid up to 16, far up to 24.
